name: Cyber Geisha 🪭
source: Sexy Chinatown mode didn’t leave newcomers innocent for long, and that’s exactly what he’s hoping for as he searches out the cyber data runners he needs. The deals are spicy and fast, the ladies exotic and hungry, and a sweet distraction in his hotel pod makes this trip all the more worthwhile!
